_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-hud (plugins/hud, ships next to the core's engine-surface.json). The custom_hud_layout's dialog-variable elements (HUDPanelDialogVariableString_t) carry a vtable, so the plugin builds them with the class's own primary vtable, found through its RTTI typeinfo name (ru_api surface_rtti_vtable, API 1.17). Nothing is called through it. The plugin patches one vtable slot, ISource2GameClients::ClientSvcUserMessage, to receive clicks on custom_hud_layout Buttons (user message 390); a slot that fails its anchors is never patched and clicks stay off. Everything else the plugin touches is schema (field offsets by name) plus entity_create / entity_spawn / entity_remove.

HUDPanelDialogVariableString_t.note: Element of CCSCustomHudLayoutState::m_vecDialogVariableStrings; the plugin writes this vtable into each element it adds.

ISource2GameClients::ClientSvcUserMessag.note: 11 IAppSystem slots + 27. Patched by readyup-hud: user message 390 (CS_UM_CustomHudClicked) is a click on a custom_hud_layout Button. On 1.41.9.x the slot calls the handler that compares the type with 390; its own code loads the strings below.
